What's your return and refund policy?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
For store purchases, you can cancel for a full refund within 3 days of purchase if the order has not shipped. Once shipped, cancellation is no longer possible; after successful delivery, returns for a change of mind or taste generally aren’t accepted. Personalized/engraved items, presales, special releases, and seasonal items are non-returnable and non-refundable unless stated otherwise. 
If there’s a problem with a delivered order, report it within 7 days of delivery with your order number, a description, and clear photos of the package and contents. 
For EU website orders, returns are permitted within 14 days of delivery under EU regulations, with postage and packaging paid by the customer.
For memberships, refund eligibility depends on cancelling within the applicable grace period and whether benefits were used: 14 days for Flaviar Black Annual and Whisky Subscriptions, or 72 hours for Legacy plans.
